title: Identity & Access Management
description: Manage user identities, group policies, and access reviews. Tests Active Directory administration, joiner-mover-leaver processes, and least-privilege design.

seo.overviewTitle: Active Directory Domain Services & Identity Access Management
seo.overviewBody: Identity is the security perimeter for enterprise IT networks. Enterprise recruiters evaluate candidates on Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) design, Group Policy Object (GPO) configuration, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and Single Sign-On (SSO) SAML integration.

deliverables.title: 1. AD Organizational Unit & GPO Blueprint
deliverables.desc: Architectural blueprint detailing Organizational Unit (OU) structure, Group Policy enforcement, and domain trust relationships.

deliverables.title: 2. RBAC Privilege Matrix & Lifecycle Script
deliverables.desc: Privilege matrix and PowerShell script automating user onboarding, role-based group assignments, and offboarding deprovisioning.

deliverables.title: 3. Identity Audit & Access Review Log
deliverables.desc: Verification audit identifying inactive user accounts, stale passwords, and excessive domain admin privileges.

faqs.question: What is the principle of least privilege in identity management?
faqs.answer: Least privilege ensures users and service accounts are granted only the minimum permissions necessary to perform their specific job responsibilities.

faqs.question: How does Group Policy Object (GPO) precedence work?
faqs.answer: GPOs process in LSMOU order: Local policy, Site level, Domain level, and Organizational Unit (OU) level, where later processed policies override earlier ones unless enforced.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Active Directory DS and Entra ID?
faqs.answer: Active Directory DS is an on-premise LDAP/Kerberos directory service, whereas Entra ID (Azure AD) is a cloud-native identity service using modern protocols like OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect.
